titulo: What If You Had to Spend $1 Billion in 30 Days?
premisa: You inherit $1 billion in a lawyer's office under one rule: if even $1 is left at midnight on day 30, you lose everything, and you can't give it away or burn it. You go on a reckless spending spree: mansion, cars and jet. Then your friends Maya, Deon and Priya each pitch an idea. You buy companies, a pro sports team and an island, but every investment pays back, so the counter goes UP. Real numbers keep the scale honest: $1 billion at 5% interest earns about $137,000 a day doing nothing. A Bugatti Chiron costs about $3 million. A 2023 MLS expansion fee was $500 million. On day 25 you still have $400 million, it's night and the counter turns red. The only way out is to build something that truly costs that much: a full hospital.
gancho: Could you spend $1 BILLION in 30 days… if one dollar left means you lose it ALL?
